evidence: CTX1-CTX3 and T0-T4 choose a bounded first release, provisional intake, explicit exclusions and staff-owned outputs.
All leaves map to C1-C5, W1-W5, goldens and selected milestones; every FM/eval relation is derived reciprocally.
W1-W5 enumerate ordered exclusive evidence and model outcomes; C1 revision checks and duplicate reuse prevent stale or extra work. No business writes or unattended human wait.
C1-C5 define scoped typed sources, draft abstention, checked evidence and tagged exception handoffInput; proposed adapter verification remains H2.
No business write adapter exists. C1/C4 check current authority and source version; C2 owns typed facts; C3 has no action permission.
H1-H5 label scope, source integration, operations, price and quality hypotheses; missing/contested evidence gets an owned packet.
F1-F3 reject free agents and full account connections; compare same storage/governance criteria across unverified cloud and open-source patterns.
M1 one W3 call, bounded timeout/no retry, reproducible USD 0.0072 cost and labelled workload/prices; alternatives and fine-tune trigger explicit.
Case-specific FM1-FM3 plus access, failure, concurrent revision, receipt, cancellation, queue, evidence and citation risks have owners and gates.

Self-contained positive and isolated negative fixtures include domain errors, timeout, cancellation, stale revision, no receipt, duplicates, missing/conflicting evidence and forged citations. Release enumerates all goldens.
R1-R5 define active minutes denominator, baseline, shadow/assist entry/exit, no automatic autonomy expansion, clustered mean experiment and breach stop.
X1 and milestone selection preserve read-only scope, missing dependencies, exact contracts and fixture index; schema validation actually ran.

Exceptional paths reach C5 without a C4.checked value. Declare a typed union handoff envelope carrying exception evidence; do not require an absent successful artifact.
Supplement domain cases with exact duplicate, evidence conflict, missing source and forged citation cases; release must include these actual IDs.
